hindi: नारद के उस वचन को सुनकर वाक्य-कुशल, धर्मात्मा महामुनि ने शिष्य-सहित उनकी पूजा की।
english: Having heard that speech of Nārada, the great sage, skilled in speech and righteous of soul, together with his disciple, honoured him.

hindi: उनके द्वारा यथावत् पूजित होकर देवर्षि नारद तब विदा माँगकर और अनुमति पाकर आकाश में चले गए।
english: Duly honoured by him, the divine sage Nārada then, having taken leave and received permission, went away into the sky.
notes: Line-final anusvāra in 'vihāyasaṃ' is the edition's convention for -m before a pause; not flagged. 'āpṛṣṭvā' is the epic gerund in -tvā despite the prefix (classical form would be āpṛcchya); kept as printed, not flagged.

words.gloss: to the world of the gods

hindi: उनके देवलोक चले जाने पर, एक मुहूर्त बाद, वह मुनि तब जाह्नवी से अदूर तमसा के तट पर गए।
english: When he had gone to the world of the gods, the sage then, after a moment, went to the bank of the Tamasā, not far from the Jāhnavī.

text_flags.why: likely typing slip: 'muhūta' is not a word; 'muhūrtam' (a moment) fits the sense; metre unaffected

notes: 'tasmin gate' is a locative absolute referring to Nārada. 'muhūrtam' taken adverbially (after a moment).
lines_deva: स मुहूतं गते तस्मिन् देवलोकं मुनिस्तदा
lines_iast: sa muhūtaṃ gate tasmin devalokaṃ munistadā

hindi: वह महामुनि तमसा के तट पर पहुँचकर, कीचड़-रहित तीर्थ को देखकर, पास में खड़े शिष्य से बोले।
english: And having reached the bank of the Tamasā and seen a bathing-place free of mud, the great sage said to the disciple standing at his side.
lines_deva: स तु तीरं समासाद्य तमसाया महामुनिः
lines_iast: sa tu tīraṃ samāsādya tamasāyā mahāmuniḥ

words.gloss: the mind of a good man

hindi: भरद्वाज, देखो, यह तीर्थ कीचड़-रहित, रमणीय और स्वच्छ जल वाला है, जैसे सज्जन मनुष्य का मन।
english: Behold, Bharadvāja, this bathing-place, free of mud, delightful, its water clear, like the mind of a good man.

hindi: तात, कलश रख दो और मेरा वल्कल दो; मैं इसी उत्तम तमसा-तीर्थ में स्नान करूँगा।
english: Set down the water-pot, dear one, and let my bark garment be given; I shall bathe in this very excellent bathing-place of the Tamasā.

hindi: महात्मा वाल्मीकि द्वारा इस प्रकार कहे जाने पर संयमी भरद्वाज ने उन गुरु मुनि का वल्कल उन्हें दे दिया।
english: Thus addressed by the great-souled Vālmīki, Bharadvāja, attentive, handed over the bark garment of that sage, his teacher.

hindi: शिष्य के हाथ से वल्कल लेकर, जितेन्द्रिय वह उस विशाल वन को चारों ओर देखते हुए विचरने लगे।
english: Taking the bark garment from his disciple's hand, he, his senses restrained, wandered about, looking all around at that vast forest.

hindi: उसके समीप ही भगवान् ने वहाँ क्रौंच पक्षियों का एक जोड़ा देखा, जो विचर रहा था, कभी अलग न होने वाला और मधुर स्वर वाला था।
english: And near it the venerable one saw there a pair of krauñca birds moving about, inseparable, sweet-voiced.
notes: krauñca: a kind of bird (curlew/crane); kept as the name.

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. √dṛś (gen. absolute)

hindi: उस जोड़े में से एक को, नर पक्षी को, पाप-निश्चय वाले, वैर के घर निषाद ने उनके देखते-देखते मार डाला।
english: From that pair, a Niṣāda, evil of intent, an abode of enmity, killed one, the male, while he looked on.
notes: 'tasya paśyataḥ' = genitive absolute, 'he' being the sage.

words.gram: m. acc. sg. pres. part. ātm. √veṣṭ

hindi: रक्त से लथपथ अंगों वाले, धरती पर तड़पते हुए उस मारे गए पक्षी को देखकर उसकी भार्या करुण स्वर में विलाप करने लगी।
english: Seeing him slain, his limbs covered in blood, writhing on the ground, his mate cried out a piteous cry.
lines_deva: भार्या तु निहतं दृष्ट्वा रुराव करुणां गिरम्
lines_iast: bhāryā tu nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā rurāva karuṇāṃ giram

words.gram: m. acc. sg. ppp caus. ni-√pat

hindi: उस पक्षी को निषाद द्वारा इस प्रकार गिराया हुआ देखकर उस धर्मात्मा ऋषि को करुणा उत्पन्न हुई।
english: And seeing that bird thus struck down by the Niṣāda, compassion arose in that righteous-souled sage.
notes: dvija here = bird (twice-born: egg and hatching); in verse 13 the same word means the brahmin.
lines_deva: तथा तु तं द्विजं दृष्ट्वा निषादेन निपातितम्
lines_iast: tathā tu taṃ dvijaṃ dṛṣṭvā niṣādena nipātitam

hindi: तब करुणा के अनुभव से "यह अधर्म है" ऐसा सोचकर, रोती हुई क्रौंची को देखकर, उस द्विज ने यह वचन कहा।
english: Then, out of his feeling of compassion, thinking "this is unrighteous", the brahmin, observing the weeping female krauñca, spoke this utterance.
notes: 'adharmo 'yam iti' is the thought that moves him; dvija = brahmin (Vālmīki) here.

hindi: हे निषाद, तुम वर्षों तक शाश्वत प्रतिष्ठा न पाओ, क्योंकि तुमने क्रौंच के जोड़े में से एक को, जो काम से मोहित था, मार डाला।
english: O Niṣāda, may you not attain everlasting repose for years, since from the pair of krauñcas you killed one, bewildered by love.
notes: pratiṣṭhā is ambiguous: firm standing / peace / fame; rendered 'repose'. 'mā ... agamaḥ' is the aorist injunctive after mā. The edition prints 'śāśvatīṃ' (acc. sg.), kept as printed and construed with pratiṣṭhām; 'samāḥ' is accusative of duration. The variant 'śāśvatīḥ samāḥ' (acc. pl.) is not this edition's reading.
lines_deva: मा निषाद प्रतिष्ठां त्वमगमः शाश्वतीं समाः
lines_iast: mā niṣāda pratiṣṭhāṃ tvamagamaḥ śāśvatīṃ samāḥ

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. vi-√īkṣ

hindi: इस प्रकार कहते हुए और विचार करते हुए उनके हृदय में यह चिन्ता हुई—"इस पक्षी के शोक से पीड़ित होकर मैंने यह क्या कह दिया?"
english: As he spoke thus and reflected, an anxious thought arose in his heart: "What is this that I have uttered, afflicted with grief for this bird?"
notes: 'asya śakuneḥ' taken as objective genitive with śokārtena (grief for this bird).

hindi: विचार करते हुए उस महाप्राज्ञ, मतिमान् ने एक निश्चय किया, और उस मुनिश्रेष्ठ ने शिष्य से यह वचन कहा।
english: Pondering, that wise one of great wisdom came to a resolve, and that bull among sages spoke these words to his disciple:

hindi: शोक से पीड़ित मुझसे जो निकला है, वह पादों में बँधा, समान अक्षरों वाला, वीणा के तार और लय से युक्त श्लोक ही हो, अन्यथा नहीं।
english: What has come forth from me, afflicted with grief, bound in quarters, with equal syllables, endowed with lute-string and rhythm, let it be a śloka (verse), and not otherwise.
notes: Play on śoka (grief) and śloka (verse) is the point of the line; kept śloka in English.
lines_deva: शोकार्तस्य प्रवृत्तो मे श्लोको भवतु नान्यथा
lines_iast: śokārtasya pravṛtto me śloko bhavatu nānyathā

hindi: उस मुनि के कहते हुए उस अनुपम वचन को शिष्य ने प्रसन्न होकर ग्रहण किया, और गुरु उससे संतुष्ट हुए।
english: The disciple, delighted, received the sage's unsurpassed utterance as he spoke it, and the teacher was pleased with him.

hindi: तब उस तीर्थ में विधिपूर्वक स्नान करके, उसी बात का चिन्तन करते हुए मुनि लौट आए।
english: Then, having performed his ablution at that bathing-place according to rule, the sage returned, pondering that very matter.
lines_deva: सोऽभिषेकं ततः कृत्वा तीर्थे तस्मिन् यथाविधि
lines_iast: so'bhiṣekaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā tīrthe tasmin yathāvidhi

hindi: तब गुरु का विनीत और श्रुतवान् शिष्य भरद्वाज भरा हुआ कलश लेकर पीछे-पीछे चला।
english: Then Bharadvāja, the teacher's humble and learned disciple, took up the full water-pot and followed behind.
notes: 'guroḥ' is taken with 'śiṣyaḥ' (the teacher's disciple); it can equally be construed with 'pṛṣṭhataḥ' (followed behind the teacher).

hindi: वह धर्मज्ञ मुनि शिष्य के साथ आश्रम में प्रवेश करके बैठ गए और ध्यान में लगे हुए अन्य कथाएँ भी करते रहे।
english: That knower of dharma, having entered the hermitage grounds with his disciple, sat down and, absorbed in meditation, talked of other things as well.

hindi: तब लोकों के कर्ता, स्वयं प्रभु, चतुर्मुख, महातेजस्वी ब्रह्मा उस मुनिश्रेष्ठ को देखने के लिए आए।
english: Then Brahmā, maker of the worlds, lord in his own right, four-faced, of great splendour, came to see that bull among sages.

hindi: तब वाल्मीकि उन्हें देखकर सहसा उठ खड़े हुए और वाणी को संयत कर, हाथ जोड़कर, विनीत होकर अत्यन्त विस्मित खड़े रहे।
english: Then Vālmīki, seeing him, rose at once and, restraining his speech, stood with palms joined, reverent and greatly astonished.

words.gloss: with water for the feet, guest-offering, seat and obeisance

hindi: उन्होंने पाद्य, अर्घ्य, आसन और वन्दन से उस देव की पूजा की, और विधिपूर्वक प्रणाम करके उस अविनाशी से कुशल पूछा।
english: He honoured that god with water for the feet, the guest-offering, a seat and obeisance; and having bowed to him according to rule, he asked the imperishable one after his well-being.
notes: 'avyayam' could also qualify 'anāmayam' (unfailing well-being); taken as an epithet of Brahmā.

hindi: फिर भगवान् ने परम पूजित आसन पर बैठकर महर्षि वाल्मीकि को आसन पर बैठने का निर्देश दिया।
english: Then the lord, having sat down on the highly honoured seat, directed the great sage Vālmīki to a seat.

words.gram: m. loc. sg. ppp upa-√viś (loc. absolute)

hindi: साक्षात् लोक-पितामह के तब बैठ जाने पर वाल्मीकि उसी विषय में लगे मन से ध्यान में डूबे रहे।
english: When the grandfather of the worlds himself was then seated, Vālmīki remained absorbed in meditation, his mind fixed on that very matter.

words.gloss: with a mind bent on enmity

hindi: वैर ठानने की बुद्धि वाले उस पापात्मा ने अनर्थ किया, जो ऐसे मधुर स्वर वाले क्रौंच को अकारण मार डाले।
english: A grievous thing was done by that evil-souled one, his mind bent on enmity, who would kill such a sweet-voiced krauñca without cause.
notes: This verse is Vālmīki's inner thought during the meditation of 26; the text does not mark it with 'iti'.

hindi: क्रौंची के विषय में बार-बार शोक करते हुए ही, अन्तर्मुख मन होकर, शोक में डूबे उन्होंने इस श्लोक को फिर गाया।
english: Grieving again and again over the female krauñca, his mind turned inward and wholly given to grief, he sang this verse once more.
notes: 'krauñcīm upa' taken as 'upa' governing krauñcīm (concerning the krauñcī); an alternative would read 'upaślokam' as one word, but no such word is attested.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. pra-√has

hindi: तब ब्रह्मा ने मुस्कराते हुए उस मुनिश्रेष्ठ से कहा—"तुमने श्लोक ही रचा है; इसमें विचार करने की आवश्यकता नहीं।"
english: Then Brahmā, smiling, said to that bull among sages: "It is a śloka indeed that you have composed; no deliberation is needed here."
lines_deva: श्लोक एव त्वया बद्धो नात्र कार्या विचारणा
lines_iast: śloka eva tvayā baddho nātra kāryā vicāraṇā

hindi: हे ब्रह्मन्, मेरी ही इच्छा से तुम्हारी यह वाणी प्रवृत्त हुई है; हे ऋषिश्रेष्ठ, तुम राम का सम्पूर्ण चरित रचो।
english: By my will alone, O brahmin, has this speech of yours come forth; compose the entire story of Rāma, O best of sages.

hindi: लोक में धर्मात्मा, गुणवान्, बुद्धिमान् और धीर राम का वृत्तान्त कहो, जैसा तुमने नारद से सुना है।
english: Tell the history of Rāma, righteous of soul, virtuous in the world, wise and steadfast, just as you heard it from Nārada.
lines_deva: वृत्तं कथय धीरस्य यथा ते नारदाच्छ्रुतम्
lines_iast: vṛttaṃ kathaya dhīrasya yathā te nāradācchrutam

words.gram: m. loc. sg. (irregular, for gen. saumitreḥ or inst.)

hindi: उस बुद्धिमान् राम का, सौमित्रि सहित, तथा राक्षसों का भी जो कुछ गुप्त और प्रकट वृत्तान्त हुआ, वह सब पूरी तरह—
english: Whatever happened, secret and public, to that wise Rāma together with Saumitri, and to the rākṣasas, in every way—
notes: 'saumitre' is the edition's reading; the form is irregular after 'saha' (expected instrumental) and alongside the genitives; the sense requires 'with Saumitri'. Not flagged as a typo. Sentence continues into verse 33.
lines_deva: रहस्यं च प्रकाशं च यद्वृत्तं तस्य धीमतः
रामस्य सह सौमित्रे राक्षसानां च सर्वशः
lines_iast: rahasyaṃ ca prakāśaṃ ca yadvṛttaṃ tasya dhīmataḥ
rāmasya saha saumitre rākṣasānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ

hindi: और वैदेही का भी जो वृत्तान्त हुआ, प्रकट हो या गुप्त, वह सब, अज्ञात भी, तुम्हें ज्ञात हो जाएगा।
english: and whatever happened to Vaidehī too, whether public or secret, all that, even what is unknown, will become known to you.
notes: Completes the sentence begun in verse 32. Vaidehī = epithet 'woman of Videha'; kept as a name.
lines_deva: वैदेह्याश्चैव यद्वृत्तं प्रकाशं यदि वा रहः
lines_iast: vaidehyāścaiva yadvṛttaṃ prakāśaṃ yadi vā rahaḥ

words.gram: stem, first member of rāma-kathām (printed apart)

hindi: इस काव्य में तुम्हारी कोई भी वाणी असत्य नहीं होगी; तुम राम की पवित्र, श्लोकबद्ध और मनोरम कथा रचो।
english: No word of yours in this poem will be false; compose the holy, delightful story of Rāma, bound in ślokas.
notes: 'rāma kathāṃ' is printed as two tokens; read as the compound rāma-kathām (a vocative 'O Rāma' makes no sense here). 'kā cid' is likewise printed apart.
lines_deva: न ते वागनृता काव्ये का चिदत्र भविष्यति
कुरु राम कथां पुण्यां श्लोकबद्धां मनोरमाम्
lines_iast: na te vāganṛtā kāvye kā cidatra bhaviṣyati
kuru rāma kathāṃ puṇyāṃ ślokabaddhāṃ manoramām

hindi: जब तक पृथ्वी पर पर्वत और नदियाँ रहेंगी, तब तक रामायण की कथा लोकों में प्रचलित रहेगी।
english: As long as mountains and rivers stand on the earth, so long will the story of the Rāmāyaṇa circulate among the worlds.

hindi: और जब तक तुम्हारी रची हुई राम की कथा प्रचलित रहेगी, तब तक तुम ऊपर और नीचे, मेरे लोकों में निवास करोगे।
english: And as long as the story of Rāma made by you circulates, so long will you dwell in my worlds, above and below.

hindi: ऐसा कहकर भगवान् ब्रह्मा वहीं अन्तर्धान हो गए; तब शिष्य-सहित मुनि वाल्मीकि विस्मय को प्राप्त हुए।
english: Having spoken thus, the lord Brahmā vanished right there; then the sage Vālmīki, with his disciple, was filled with astonishment.

words.gram: m. nom. pl. pres. part. pass. √prī

hindi: तब उनके सब शिष्यों ने इस श्लोक को फिर गाया, और बार-बार प्रसन्न होते हुए, अत्यन्त विस्मित होकर वे बोले।
english: Then all his disciples sang this verse again, and, delighting again and again, greatly amazed, they said:
lines_deva: तस्य शिष्यास्ततः सर्वे जगुः श्लोकमिमं पुनः
lines_iast: tasya śiṣyāstataḥ sarve jaguḥ ślokamimaṃ punaḥ

words.gloss: the state of being a śloka

hindi: महर्षि ने समान अक्षरों वाले चार पादों में जो गाया, वह शोक बार-बार उच्चारण से श्लोकत्व को प्राप्त हो गया।
english: What the great sage sang in four quarters of equal syllables, that grief, through repeated utterance, has become a śloka.
notes: The disciples' words: the śoka/śloka pun stated outright.

hindi: पवित्र आत्मा वाले उस वाल्मीकि के मन में यह विचार उत्पन्न हुआ—"मैं ऐसे ही श्लोकों से सम्पूर्ण रामायण काव्य की रचना करूँ।"
english: This thought arose in Vālmīki, whose soul was purified: "Let me compose the entire Rāmāyaṇa poem in verses such as these."

words.gloss: with noble metre, meaning and words

hindi: तब उस कीर्तिमान्, उदार बुद्धि वाले मुनि ने उदार छन्द, अर्थ और पदों वाले, मनोरम, समान अक्षरों वाले सैकड़ों श्लोकों से इस यशस्वी राम का यश बढ़ाने वाला काव्य रचा।
english: Then the famous, noble-minded sage composed, in hundreds of delightful ślokas of equal syllables, with noble metre, meaning and words, the fame-bringing poem of this glorious Rāma.
notes: Closing verse in a longer metre with 12-syllable pādas (jagatī class). The edition marks the pāda break inside the line with a raised mark (Devanagari U+0951), which came through in IAST as a combining mark on 'manoramais̭' and 'yaśasvino̭'; it is a pāda marker, not part of the word, so src is kept as printed and not flagged. 'udāravṛtta' could also mean 'noble conduct' (of Rāma); taken as metre alongside artha and pada.
